items.summary: MarkTechPost'un rehberinde, Crawlee for Python kullanarak eksiksiz bir web tarama iş akışı anlatılıyor. BeautifulSoupCrawler, ParselCrawler ve PlaywrightCrawler ile demo website taranıyor, başlıklar ve ürün bilgileri çıkarılıyor. Veriler normalize edilerek link grafiği oluşturuluyor ve JSON, CSV, RAG-ready JSONL formatlarında dışa aktarılıyor.
items.originalTitle: Crawlee for Python: Build a Web Crawling Pipeline with Robots Handling, Link Graphs, and RAG Chunk Export
items.originalSummary:
In this tutorial, we build a complete Crawlee for Python workflow from setup to AI-ready output. We generate a local demo website, then crawl it with BeautifulSoupCrawler, ParselCrawler, and PlaywrightCrawler. We extract titles, metadata, product fields, and JavaScript-rendered cards, and capture full-page screenshots. We then normalize the data, build a link graph, and export JSON, CSV, and RAG-ready JSONL chunks.
The post Crawlee for Python: Build a Web Crawling Pipeline with Robots Handling, Link Graphs, and RAG Chunk Export appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Cisco, FAPO ile LLM Pipeline'larını Otomatik Optimize Ediyor
items.summary: Cisco Foundation AI, Claude Code tabanlı FAPO (Fully Automated Prompt Optimization) sistemini açık kaynak olarak yayınladı. Sistem, çok adımlı LLM pipeline'larını otomatik olarak optimize ediyor, her adımdaki başarısızlıkları belirliyor ve prompt, parametre ve zincir yapısı seviyesinde iyileştirmeler öneriyor. Cisco'nun testlerinde FAPO, 18 model-benchmark karşılaştırmasının 15'inde GEPA'yı geçmiştir.
items.originalTitle: Cisco AI Introduces FAPO: Pipeline-Aware Prompt Optimization With Step-Level Failure Attribution and Claude Code Orchestration
items.originalSummary:
Cisco Foundation AI has open-sourced FAPO (Fully Automated Prompt Optimization), a Claude Code-driven system that autonomously optimizes multi-step LLM pipelines from baseline prompts to target accuracy. FAPO evaluates a chain, attributes failures at the step level, proposes variants across prompt, parameter, and chain-structure levels, and validates each through an independent reviewer. In Cisco's evaluation, it beat GEPA on 15 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. Here's how the optimization loop works and how to run it.
The post Cisco AI Introduces FAPO: Pipeline-Aware Prompt Optimization With Step-Level Failure Attribution and Claude Code Orchestration appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Yandex, Protobuf için YaFF formatını açık kaynak yaptı
items.summary: Yandex, Protobuf ekosistemi için zero-copy wire format olan YaFF'ı açık kaynak hale getirdi. YaFF, .proto dosyasını tek kaynak olarak tutarken, verilerin bellekteki yerleşimini değiştirerek Fixed, Flat, Sparse ve Dynamic olmak üzere dört düzey sunuyor. Flat Layout, C++ struct okuma hızının 1.2 katı içinde performans göstererek, üretim ortamında reklam sistemi için %10-20 CPU tasarrufu sağlamıştır.
items.originalTitle: Yandex Open-Sources YaFF: A Zero-Copy Wire Format for Protobuf With Near-Struct Read Speed
items.originalSummary:
In this article we look at YaFF, Yandex's open-source zero-copy wire format for the Protobuf ecosystem. We keep the .proto file as the single source of truth, changing only how data sits in memory. We walk through its four layouts — Fixed, Flat, Sparse, and Dynamic — and the benchmark where Flat Layout reads within 1.2× of a raw C++ struct. We also cover where it fits, including the advertising recommendation system reporting 10–20% CPU savings at production scale.
The post Yandex Open-Sources YaFF: A Zero-Copy Wire Format for Protobuf With Near-Struct Read Speed appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: TimeCopilot ile Tahmin Sistemi Kurulumu

Gerçek havayolu yolcu verileri ve sentetik mevsimsel seriler üzerinde istatistiksel ve foundation modelleri değerlendirilmiş, tahmin aralıkları ve gelecek trendler görselleştirilmiştir. Sistemin LLM agent seçeneği modeli seçip tahminlerini açıklayabilmektedir.
items.originalTitle: How to Build a Forecasting Pipeline with TimeCopilot Using Foundation Models and Automated Anomaly Detection
items.originalSummary:
We build an end-to-end forecasting workflow with TimeCopilot on a panel of real airline passenger data and a synthetic seasonal series with injected anomalies. We evaluate statistical, foundation, and optional GPU-based models using rolling cross-validation and multiple error metrics. We generate probabilistic forecasts with prediction intervals, visualize future trends, and flag unusual observations. We then explore TimeCopilot's optional LLM agent, which selects a model and explains its predictions.
The post How to Build a Forecasting Pipeline with TimeCopilot Using Foundation Models and Automated Anomaly Detection appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.originalTitle: Salesforce CodeGen Tutorial: Generate, Validate, and Rerank Python Functions With Unit Tests and Safety Checks
items.originalSummary:
We implement an end-to-end workflow for Salesforce CodeGen, loaded from Hugging Face. We move past basic inference by adding function extraction, syntax checking, static safety checks, and unit-test validation. We rerank best-of-N candidates, compose multi-turn program synthesis, and experiment with prompt styles. We finish by visualizing a mini benchmark and exporting the generated artifacts as reusable files.
The post Salesforce CodeGen Tutorial: Generate, Validate, and Rerank Python Functions With Unit Tests and Safety Checks appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.originalTitle: The KV Cache Compression Race: TurboQuant vs OSCAR vs EpiCache
items.originalSummary:
The KV cache now outweighs model weights at long context. Here's how TurboQuant, OSCAR, and EpiCache each attack that memory bottleneck — and why they're more complementary than competitive.

items.originalTitle: OpenAI Releases LifeSciBench, a 750-Task Benchmark Grading AI Models on Real Life-Science Research With Expert-Written Rubric
items.originalSummary:
OpenAI's LifeSciBench evaluates whether frontier AI can handle real life-science research across 750 expert-authored tasks, seven workflows, and seven biological domains. Built by 173 PhD scientists with 19,020 rubric criteria, it grades reasoning and decisions, not just recall. The best model, GPT-Rosalind, passes 36.1%, leaving large headroom on artifacts, exact outputs, and operational calls.

items.title: NVIDIA SkillSpector ile AI Becerilerinde Güvenlik Taraması

items.originalTitle: NVIDIA SkillSpector Guide: Scanning AI Skills for Security Risks with Static Analysis and SARIF Reports
items.originalSummary:
In this tutorial, we use NVIDIA SkillSpector to evaluate AI skills for security risks before deployment. We build a corpus of benign and deliberately vulnerable skills, then scan them through SkillSpector's programmatic LangGraph workflow. We organize the risk scores and findings with pandas, then visualize severity and category distributions. We export results in SARIF format, register a custom analyzer, and optionally apply an LLM-based semantic pass.
The post NVIDIA SkillSpector Guide: Scanning AI Skills for Security Risks with Static Analysis and SARIF Reports appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: MiniMax, blok tabanlı sparse attention yöntemi MSA'yı sundu
items.summary: MiniMax, Grouped Query Attention üzerine inşa edilen MSA (MiniMax Sparse Attention) adlı bir sparse attention yöntemi yayınladı. Hafif bir Index Branch tarafından seçilen bloklar üzerinde işlem yapan sistem, GQA ile aynı performans gösterirken 1M context'te token başına dikkat hesaplamasını 28,4 kat azaltıyor.
items.originalTitle: MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA): a Two-Branch Block-Sparse Attention Trained on a 109B-Parameter MoE With a 3T-Token Budget
items.originalSummary:
MiniMax released MSA, a sparse attention built on Grouped Query Attention. A lightweight Index Branch selects Top-k key-value blocks per query and GQA group; the Main Branch attends only to those blocks. It matches GQA on downstream benchmarks while reducing per-token attention compute 28.4× at 1M context.
The post MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA): a Two-Branch Block-Sparse Attention Trained on a 109B-Parameter MoE With a 3T-Token Budget appeared first on MarkTechPost.
